nl.title: Mailboxquota en volle mailboxen in CyberPanel
nl.excerpt: Mailboxquota en volle mailboxen in CyberPanel: praktische handleiding in CyberPanel, met stappen, controles en wanneer je TripleZero iT support inschakelt.
nl.bodyHtml:
Een volle mailbox weigert nieuwe mail. In CyberPanel verhoog je quota of ruim je op.

Oplossen

  1. Bekijk quota per mailbox in Email-beheer.
  2. Verwijder grote bijlagen / oude mappen via webmail of IMAP.
  3. Verhoog quota binnen pakketlimieten.
  4. Informeer gebruikers bij structureel tekort — of upgrade.

Heb je na het volgen van deze stappen nog vragen? Neem contact op met TripleZero iT support via het ticketssysteem. Vermeld hostname, CyberPanel-URL en wat je precies ziet (foutmelding of screenshot).

Gerelateerd: Uitgaande mail queue; resourcegebruik.

en.title: Mailboxquota and volle mailboxen in CyberPanel
en.excerpt: Create or manage a mailbox in DirectAdmin Email Accounts.
en.bodyHtml:
“Mailboxquota and volle mailboxen in CyberPanel” is handled per domain in DirectAdmin → Email Accounts.

Preparation

  • DirectAdmin login
  • Desired address
  • Strong password

Steps

  1. Select the domain in DirectAdmin.
  2. Open Email Accounts.
  3. Create Account / change quota or password.
  4. Test in webmail with full address + mailbox password.

Verify

  • Webmail login works

Tip: Note IMAP/SMTP from the welcome email for desktop clients.

Note: Do not paste mailbox passwords into tickets.

Still stuck? Open a ticket with TripleZero iT via the client panel. Include your domain name, what you already tried, and any exact error messages (text or screenshot).

Related: Webmail, SPF, quota.
